title: Made a shuriken throwing game with Claude, where spin makes it curve. Would love some feedback
author: real-pies-realpies
selftext:
Been working on a target hitting / bit of a puzzle game, with the emphasis on the feel of throwing a shuriken. When you spin it, it curves at different angles depending on how much spin you put on it.

All the code was done with Claude. I came up with the idea and the levels, and did a lot of playing and going back and forth on how it felt. The hardest part was getting the throw and the curve to feel satisfying rather than floaty, and the hit on the target not to look glitchy. I've personally completed every level multiple times and made sure a bullseye is possible on all of them. 

I wanted to make something I'd find fun, so I'm not sure how others will find it. The only feedback I've had so far is that it felt incomplete, so I stripped it right back to just the levels on a path.  
Please let me know if you enjoy it. Any feedback, good or bad, is appreciated.
